a1
God tested Abraham: take Isaac, your only son, whom you love, and offer him on a mountain I will show you.
b1
Early next morning, Abraham set out with Isaac, two servants, and wood.
c1
On the third day he saw the place. We will worship, he told his servants, and come back.
c2
Isaac carried the wood, Abraham the fire and the knife.
c3
Isaac asked: where is the lamb? Abraham said: God himself will provide the lamb.
d1
At the place God named, Abraham built an altar and bound Isaac.
d2
As he reached for the knife, the Lord's angel called: Abraham! Do not harm the boy.
d3
Now I know you fear God, for you did not withhold your son.
e1
Abraham saw a ram caught in a thicket, and offered it instead.
e2
He named the place: the Lord will provide.
e3
The angel promised: through your descendants all nations will be blessed.
h1
Abraham trusted God with the very thing God had promised.
h2
He did not know the ending. He said: God himself will provide.
h3
Faith is not knowing how God will provide. It is walking on with him anyway.
h4
Today, place what you fear losing into God's hands.
i
What is hardest for you to trust God with?
